model_or_test: Gaussian LMM, temp x wound x day x patch, (1|tank)+(1|id), REML, Satterthwaite type III
diagnostics_run: convergence; singular fit; rank; DHARMa uniformity/dispersion/outliers; residual SD by temperature + Levene; |resid| vs fitted; lag-1 within-fragment autocorrelation; day^2 curvature; random day slopes per fragment and per tank; unequal variance by temperature (nlme varIdent); leave-one-tank-out
diagnostic_outcome: Converged, not singular, full rank. Uniformity p=0.11; no autocorrelation (r=-0.01); no curvature (dAIC +1.8). Heated residual SD 1.6x ambient (Levene p<0.001). Day slopes per tank strongly preferred (dAIC -29). With them, temp x day F=18-20 on ~6 df, p=0.004 (reported F=120, df 228). Wound terms unchanged (p>0.17 in every variant). LOTO: temp x day p<1e-17 in all 8 drops.
changes_conclusion: No: heat lowers Fv/Fm over time in every structure. Yes for how strong it looks: the reported F and df treat each observation as an independent slope.
next_fix: Report temperature x day from a model with day slopes per tank, e.g. (1 + day || tank) + (1 | id).

model_or_test: Gaussian LMM on 1-6 card score, same structure as A; tank-level exact permutation on final color
diagnostics_run: as A, plus ordinal-model attempt and tank permutation
diagnostic_outcome: Residuals not normal (uniformity p=2e-11): 220 of 288 post-Day-0 scores are 4 and ambient almost never changes. Heated residual SD 2.9x ambient. Day slopes per tank preferred (dAIC -36); temp x day F=34-38 on ~6 df, p<0.001 (reported F=288). Ordinal model cannot be estimated (near separation). model_or_test: Gaussian LMM on log(cells/cm2), temp x wound x biopsy day x patch, (1|tank); each fragment sampled once
diagnostics_run: as A (no autocorrelation: one sample per fragment); DHARMa outliers identified and refit without them; day slope per tank; nlme varIdent
diagnostic_outcome: Uniformity p=0.012, outliers p=0.001: 5 heated Day-15 patch-A fragments, 3 nearly bleached out (13,000-19,000 cells/cm2). Heated residual SD 2.3x ambient. Slope per tank preferred (dAIC -28): temp x day F=17-20 on ~6-7 df, p=0.003-0.006 (reported F=95). 3-way temp x wound x day: reported p=0.11; 0.08 with slopes or unequal variance; 0.003 without the 5 outliers; LOTO 0.01-0.35. Its direction is that heated wounded fragments kept MORE symbionts (Day-15 geometric mean 135k vs 105k cells/cm2).
changes_conclusion: No for heat. The wound result is fragile: 'clipping added nothing' is not robust for symbionts, and if anything wounding went with smaller symbiont losses.
next_fix: Keep the outliers (they look like real bleaching); report the tank-slope model and say the wound x heat x day term is sensitive to the most-bleached patch-A fragments.

model_or_test: Weibull AFT on (last no, first yes] intervals, right-censored at Day 15, + patch
diagnostics_run: events/censoring; distribution choice (Weibull, lognormal, log-logistic, exponential) by AIC; tank-clustered robust SE; ties
diagnostic_outcome: Budding: time ratio 1.26-1.32 across Weibull, lognormal and log-logistic (best fits, dAIC<0.6); p 1e-7 to 2e-6, but 8 of 12 heated fragments never budded, so the ratio extrapolates past Day 15, and with 8 tanks clustered SEs are unreliable. Tip extension: Weibull is the worst-fitting distribution (dAIC 12.2); its p=0.023 becomes 0.09 (lognormal) and 0.14 (log-logistic). Wound smoothing: Weibull p=0.022, 0.10-0.14 under better-fitting distributions. Scoring every 2-3 days leaves heavy ties (2-4 distinct event days per stage).
changes_conclusion: Budding: no (direction and size are stable). Tip extension 'took somewhat longer': yes, it depends on the Weibull choice.
next_fix: Pick the distribution by AIC per stage or report log-logistic; drop the tip-extension timing claim or call it uncertain; use the tank permutation for budding inference.
